rootCause: A mechanically nicer outline-aware placement can be less routeable than a verified compact topology.
fixSummary: Score routeability and manufacturability before promotion. Promote clean verified fallback over prettier incomplete layouts.

conditions: one candidate is cleaner by validation

recipe: Score each candidate by shorts, forbidden vias, unconnected count, DRC, connector geometry, and area.
Reject manufacturing promotion if unconnected or DRC remains.
Use verified fallback topology when custom outline routeability stalls.
safetyRules: do not export manufacturing package unless DRC/ERC/connectivity are clean
